sentences.text: On 24th August 2025, Mrs. Mohini Puri, a 76 years of lady and mother of the Respondent No.3, was admitted by the Respondent No.3 to the Emergency Department of Petitioner No. 2 hospital, for imbalance and weakness.

The Petitioner No. 2 Hospital has been taking care of the medical needs of the patient since August 2025.

The Respondent No.3 after making initial payments, on the ground of medical negligence has refused and failed to make the balance payment of the medical bills and also refused to take discharge of his mother/patient from the Petitioner No.2 Hospital.
The outstanding bill, as contended to be payable is about Rs 16,00,000/ -.
